name: Wavypoint Product Widgets
author: wavypoint

sections.description:
Wavypoint Product Widgets is a collection of powerful WooCommerce widgets for Elementor that helps you create modern, engaging, and high-converting online stores without writing code.

Design beautiful shop pages, product showcases, featured collections, and landing pages using professionally crafted widgets with extensive customization options.

Whether you’re building a fashion store, electronics shop, furniture website, or any WooCommerce-powered business, Wavypoint Product Widgets gives you the flexibility to create unique shopping experiences that stand out.

Features:

  • Professional WooCommerce widgets for Elementor
  • Beautiful product grid layouts
  • Glassmorphism product cards
  • Modern hover animations
  • Interactive product effects
  • Fully responsive design
  • Extensive Elementor style controls
  • Lightweight and performance optimized
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes
  • No coding required
  • SEO-friendly code
  • Regular feature updates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins page.
  3. Make sure Elementor and WooCommerce are installed and activated.
  4. Open any page with Elementor.
  5. Find the Wavy widgets in the Elementor panel and start building your store.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is required because the widgets display WooCommerce products.

Is it responsive?

Yes. Every widget is fully responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Will more widgets be added?

Absolutely. We are committed to expanding the plugin with new WooCommerce widgets and features every month.
